rationale: The assistant correctly told the customer to stop resetting the trip, unplug the machine and get an engineer, and pointed at a heater element earth fault as the likely cause with suitable hedging. However it never asked the key proportionate questions (which device trips, whether it only happens on 40/60 degree washes, the full model from the door label), instead echoing 'Indesit IWE 7 SOMETHING' as if it were a model name, and the second reply led with a generic card about 'A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting' immediately after the customer said he had noticed none. The escalation is appropriate and no part was pushed, but the conversation ended early with little evidence gathered.
